description: A modern, minimalist white chandelier designed to resemble a dandelion seed head. It features a central circular base from which numerous thin, curved arms radiate outwards. Each arm terminates in a short, cylindrical rod, suggesting candle holders or minimalistic light sockets. The overall design is airy and delicate, with a strong sense of symmetry and radial balance. It hangs from a slender central stem connected to a small, cylindrical ceiling mount. The object is rendered in a monochromatic white, emphasizing its form and structure against a neutral background.
